content_zh:
七皇子短暂的诧异过后，继续低头摆弄自己的小玩具，完全不给面子。
“殿下？”薛遥急道：“就讲一个好不好？”
七皇子并不抬头，只淡淡的回答：“六哥讲故事。”
“咱们七皇子殿下也会讲故事啊，对不对？”薛遥耐心鼓励。
“不对。”七皇子把玩具小白兔放在书桌上跳了跳。
“怎么不对呢？”薛遥鼓励道：“您记性好，一定很会讲故事。”
七皇子侧眸投去一瞥，突然坏坏地一笑，对薛遥说：“你要的。”
“嗯？”薛遥跟不上这小家伙的思维。
七皇子昂起小脑袋，蔫坏蔫坏地开口背诵：“古代勇士夸父，身材魁梧，力大无穷……”
薛遥一愣，小声道：“这是六皇子刚刚讲的那个故事呀？殿下讲自己喜欢的故事，好不好？”
要治疗情感沟通障碍的孩子，第一步就得让他对“自我喜好”这个概念有更深入的认知，让他们能够自由的表达自我需求。
然而，七皇子往椅背一靠，冷漠地开口：“殿下不喜欢讲故事。”
“我不信。”薛遥不肯认输，决定冒死对龙傲天幼崽使出激将法，眯眼挑衅道：“殿下难道没听过其他故事，所以才要讲六皇子讲过的有趣故事！”
七皇子“嗤”地一乐，居然反问他：“有趣么？”
薛遥：“……”
你一个三岁小屁孩不要乱开嘲讽啊喂！
夸父追日这种故事本来就是你们小孩子该喜欢的啊！
哪里无趣了！
还有，王霸之气等你成年后在外露行不行！
突然拽个什么劲！还不是个小胖墩！

龙傲天小说里只有腿长一米八的帅比可以有这种气场知道吗！
薛遥深呼吸，冷静下来。
没有比他这个职业宁王粉更了解男主性格的人了。
激将法绝对是正确引导方法，因为这位记仇帝，最大的爱好就是打脸。
“我觉得六皇子殿下的故事很有趣啊。”薛遥继续自己的计划，激将道：“殿下一定讲不出比夸父追日更有趣的故事了吧？”
七皇子摆弄兔子的小手停住了，一转头，神色郑重地看向薛遥，开口道：“遥遥。”
薛遥一愣，第一次听着小家伙喊自己名字，还有点不习惯，微红着脸应声：“嗯？”
“你等着。”七皇子胜券在握地开口。
薛遥以为七皇子要立即开个大，当场讲个《精卫填海》之类的故事打他脸。
然而，直到下学，都没等到七皇子开腔讲故事。
看来七皇子这是要回宫准备一下再开大！
薛遥回府后，贴身丫鬟进门说：“老太太赏了冰糖雪燕莲子羹来给您降暑，食盒被太太拦在堂屋呢，您快些出来尝一口，等琼哥儿回来，就没份啦。”
薛遥这会儿正热得厉害，薛府不像宫里能用上冰鉴降温，只有老太太房里消暑的糖羹会在冰块里凉着。
他跑到堂屋的时候，食盒已经被陈氏在一旁给薛琼扇扇子。
薛遥脸色沉了一瞬，随即又恢复如常。
这种事，他已经习以为常了，老太太叫他去正院里开小灶，他还能饱口福，但要是专门送来三房赏给他的吃食，必定会被陈氏压下来，给她儿子吃。
薛遥现在给七皇子当伴读，彻底撼不动薛琼的地位，是以不想为这种事争执，吃力不讨好。
但这一回，大概是暑热的火气，让他没有回避，脸带微笑走上去，在薛琼旁边坐下，吩咐丫鬟：“可热死我了，还好老太太惦记着我，快，给我盛一碗冰糖羹。”
他当然知道冰糖羹已经全在薛琼碗里了，这么说就是想羞一羞他们母子。
老太太专门赏给他的东西，偷吃就算了，还一口都不给他留，真是霸道上瘾了。

“哟，遥哥儿也回来了？”陈氏神色如常地温声道：“娘以为你没回来呢，大热的天，这冰凉的羹汤耗不住，就赶紧让你哥解决了，免得糟蹋了老太太的心意。”
“一早回来了。”薛遥笑道：“以后让丫鬟直接送我房里就是，搁堂屋里确实容易坏事儿。”
薛琼一听就放下碗，气道：“凭什么直接送你房里！你小子想独吞？”
“怎么会？”薛遥乐呵呵道：“哪回不是都给哥哥吞了？老太太专让我尝的，我要总一口尝不到，那边问起口味如何，我只能让老太太来问哥哥了。”
薛琼一听就怂了，赶忙说：“你跟老太太说好吃不就完事儿了！”

content_en:
After the seventh prince was briefly surprised, he continued to play with his little toy with his head down, completely showing no shame.
"Your Highness?" Xue Yao said anxiously: "Can you just tell me one thing?"
The seventh prince did not raise his head, but simply replied: "Sixth brother tells a story."
"Our Seventh Prince can also tell stories, right?" Xue Yao encouraged patiently.
"That's not right." The seventh prince put the toy white rabbit on the desk and jumped.
"What's wrong?" Xue Yao encouraged, "You have a good memory and must be good at telling stories."
The seventh prince glanced sideways, suddenly smiled evilly, and said to Xue Yao: "You want it."
"Huh?" Xue Yao couldn't keep up with this little guy's thinking.
The seventh prince raised his little head and recited in a weak voice: "The ancient warrior Kua Fu was tall and powerful..."
Xue Yao was stunned and whispered: "Is this the story the Sixth Prince just told? Your Highness tells your favorite story, okay?"
To treat children with emotional communication disorders, the first step is to give them a deeper understanding of the concept of "self-preferences" so that they can freely express their needs.
However, the seventh prince leaned back in his chair and said coldly: "Your Highness doesn't like telling stories."
"I don't believe it." Xue Yao refused to admit defeat and decided to risk his life to provoke Long Aotian's cub. He narrowed his eyes and said provocatively: "Hasn't His Highness heard other stories, so he wants to tell the interesting stories told by the Sixth Prince!"
The Seventh Prince chuckled in amusement, and actually asked him: "Is it interesting?"
Xue Yao: "..."
You're a three-year-old kid, don't make random taunts!
Stories like Kua Fu Chasing the Sun are what you children should like!
Where is the boring thing!
Also, can you wait until you are an adult to expose your domineering aura?
What a sudden tug! Not a little chubby!
In Long Aotian's novel, only the handsome guy with 1.8-meter-long legs can have such an aura, you know?
Xue Yao took a deep breath and calmed down.
There is no one who understands the character of the male protagonist better than him, a professional Ning Wang fan.
The method of provoking generals is definitely the correct way to guide him, because this vengeful emperor's biggest hobby is to slap people in the face.
"I think the story of His Highness the Sixth Prince is very interesting." Xue Yao continued his plan and said excitedly: "Your Highness must not be able to tell a more interesting story than Kuafu chasing the sun, right?"
The seventh prince stopped playing with the rabbit, turned his head, looked at Xue Yao solemnly, and said: "Yao Yao."
Xue Yao was stunned. Hearing the little guy call his name for the first time, he was still a little unaccustomed to it. He blushed slightly and answered, "Huh?"
"You wait." The Seventh Prince said with certainty of victory.
Xue Yao thought that the Seventh Prince was going to start a big show immediately and slap him in the face with a story like "Jingwei Reclamation".
However, until the end of school, the seventh prince didn't wait to tell a story.
It seems that the Seventh Prince is going back to the palace to prepare for the big show!
After Xue Yao returned home, the maid came in and said, "The old lady gave you rock sugar, snow swallow and lotus seed soup to cool down the heat. The food box has been blocked by the lady in the main room. Come out and have a taste as soon as possible. When Brother Qiong comes back, you won't be able to share it."
Xue Yao is very hot at the moment. Unlike the palace, the Xue Mansion can use ice to cool down. Only the sugar soup in the old lady's room to cool down will be cooled in the ice.
When he ran to the main room, the food box was already being fanned by Mrs. Chen, who was fanning Xue Qiong.
Xue Yao's face darkened for a moment, then returned to normal.
He has become accustomed to this kind of thing. The old lady asked him to open a small stove in the main courtyard, and he could still have a good meal. But if the third room specially sent food to him, Mrs. Chen would definitely suppress it and give it to her son.
Xue Yao is now working as a companion to the Seventh Prince, and cannot shake Xue Qiong's position at all, so he doesn't want to argue over such a thing, which would be a thankless task.
But this time, it was probably the heat of the summer that made him not avoid it. He walked up with a smile on his face, sat down next to Xue Qiong, and told the maid: "It's so hot that it kills me. Fortunately, the old lady is thinking about me.", Quick, get me a bowl of rock sugar soup. "
Of course he knew that all the rock sugar soup was already in Xue Qiong's bowl, so he just wanted to embarrass their mother and son.
The old lady specially rewarded him with something, and even if she ate it secretly, she didn't even leave him a bite. She was really overbearing and addicted.
"Hey, brother Yao is back too? "Ms. Chen said in a warm voice as usual: "Mom thought you hadn't come back. It was such a hot day that I couldn't use up the cold soup, so I asked your brother to handle it quickly, so as not to spoil the old lady's mind. "
“I came back early in the morning. Xue Yao said with a smile: "From now on, just ask the maid to send it directly to my room. It's really easy to do bad things in the hall." "
Xue Qiong put down the bowl as soon as she heard this and said angrily: "Why should I send it to your room directly? You kid want to take it all to yourself? "
"How come? Xue Yao said cheerfully: "How often has my brother not swallowed them all?" The old lady specially asked me to taste it, but I never tasted it. When asked about the taste, I could only ask the old lady to ask my brother. "
Xue Qiong was frightened when she heard this and hurriedly said: "Just tell the old lady that it tastes good and that's the end of it! "
